(minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t        }\n686\t\n687\t        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n688\t    }\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t// ============================================================================\n692\t// Validation\n693\t// ============================================================================\n694\t\n695\tbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t 0x1.fffffep-1f : f;\n}\n\nstatic void mtSeedWindow(uint32_t seed, uint32_t* w) {\n    w[0] = seed;\n    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < MT_N; ++i) w[i] = 1812433253u * (w[i - 1] ^ (w[i - 1] >> 30)) + i;\n}\n\nusing Poly = std::vector<uint64_t>;   // GF(2) polynomial, bit k = coefficient of x^k\n\n// GF(2) polynomial arithmetic modulo the MT19937 characteristic polynomial\nstruct MtPoly {\n    Poly p;                               // monic, degree MT_DEG\n    std::vector<Poly> pShift;             // p << s, s = 0..63 (POLY_WORDS + 1 words)\n\n    // Characteristic polynomial via Berlekamp-Massey on the MSB sequence\n    void init() {\n        const int nseq = 2 * MT_DEG + 64;\n        std::vector<uint32_t> x(nseq);\n        mtSeedWindow(42u, x.data());\n        for (int k = MT_N; k < nseq; ++k) x[k] = mtWord(x[k - MT_N], x[k - MT_N + 1], x[k - (MT_N - MT_M)]);\n\n        const int nw = (nseq + 63) / 64 + 2 * POLY_WORDS + 8;\n        std::vector<uint64_t> R(nw, 0);   // R[j] = s[nseq-1-j]\n        for (int k = 0; k < nseq; ++k) {\n            if (x[k] >> 31) {\n                int j = nseq - 1 - k;\n                R[j >> 6] |= 1ull << (j & 63);\n            }\n        }\n        auto bitsAt = [&](int off) -> uint64_t {\n            int w = off >> 6, s = off & 63;\n            return s ? (R[w] >> s) | (R[w + 1] << (64 - s)) : R[w];\n        };\n        const int cw = 2 * POLY_WORDS + 4;\n        std::vector<uint64_t> C(cw, 0), B(cw, 0), T(cw, 0);\n        C[0] = 1; B[0] = 1;\n        int L = 0, m = 1;\n        auto xorShift = [&](std::vector<uint64_t>& dst, const std::vector<uint64_t>& src, int sh) {\n            int ws = sh >> 6, bs = sh & 63;\n            int lim = POLY_WORDS + 2;\n            for (int q = lim - 1; q >= 0; --q) {\n                uint64_t v = src[q];\n                if (!v) continue;\n                if (q + ws < cw) dst[q + ws] ^= v << bs;\n                if (bs && q + ws + 1 < cw) dst[q + ws + 1] ^= v >> (64 - bs);\n            }\n        };\n        for (int n = 0; n < 2 * MT_DEG + 8; ++n) {\n            int o = nseq - 1 - n;\n            uint64_t acc = 0;\n            int lw = L / 64 + 1;\n            for (int q = 0; q < lw; ++q) acc ^= C[q] & bitsAt(o + 64 * q);\n            if (__builtin_popcountll(acc) & 1) {\n                if (2 * L <= n) {\n                    T = C;\n                    xorShift(C, B, m);\n                    L = n + 1 - L;\n                    B = T;\n                    m = 1;\n                } else {\n                    xorShift(C, B, m);\n                    ++m;\n                }\n            } else {\n                ++m;\n            }\n        }\n        if (L != MT_DEG) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Berlekamp-Massey failed (L=%d)\\n\", L);\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        p.assign(POLY_WORDS + 1, 0);\n        for (int i = 0; i <= L; ++i) {\n            if ((C[i >> 6] >> (i & 63)) & 1) {\n                int k = L - i;\n                p[k >> 6] |= 1ull << (k & 63);\n            }\n        }\n        pShift.assign(64, Poly(POLY_WORDS + 2, 0));\n        for (int s = 0; s < 64; ++s) {\n            for (int q = 0; q <= POLY_WORDS; ++q) {\n                pShift[s][q] ^= p[q] << s;\n                if (s) pShift[s][q + 1] ^= p[q] >> (64 - s);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Reduce a polynomial of degree < 2*MT_DEG (2*POLY_WORDS words) in place\n    void reduce(Poly& a) const {\n        for (int k = 2 * MT_DEG; k >= MT_DEG; --k) {\n            if ((a[k >> 6] >> (k & 63)) & 1) {\n                int off = k - MT_DEG;\n                const uint64_t* ps = pShift[off & 63].data();\n                uint64_t* dst = a.data() + (off >> 6);\n                for (int q = 0; q < POLY_WORDS + 1; ++q) dst[q] ^= ps[q];\n            }\n        }\n        a.resize(POLY_WORDS);\n    }\n\n    static uint64_t spread(uint32_t v) {\n        uint64_t x = v;\n        x = (x | (x << 16)) & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFull;\n        x = (x | (x << 8)) & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull;\n        x = (x | (x << 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full;\n        x = (x | (x << 2)) & 0x3333333333333333ull;\n        x = (x | (x << 1)) & 0x5555555555555555ull;\n        return x;\n    }\n\n    Poly squareMod(const Poly& a) const {\n        Poly r(2 * POLY_WORDS + 2, 0);\n        for (int q = 0; q < POLY_WORDS; ++q) {\n            r[2 * q] = spread(static_cast<uint32_t>(a[q]));\n            r[2 * q + 1] = spread(static_cast<uint32_t>(a[q] >> 32));\n        }\n        reduce(r);\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    void mulXMod(Poly& a) const {\n        uint64_t carry = 0;\n        for (int q = 0; q < POLY_WORDS; ++q) {\n            uint64_t nc = a[q] >> 63;\n            a[q] = (a[q] << 1) | carry;\n            carry = nc;\n        }\n        if ((a[MT_DEG >> 6] >> (MT_DEG & 63)) & 1) {\n            for (int q = 0; q < POLY_WORDS; ++q) a[q] ^= p[q];\n        }\n    }\n\n    // x^e mod p\n    Poly powX(uint64_t e) const {\n        Poly r(POLY_WORDS, 0);\n        r[0] = 1;\n        if (e == 0) return r;\n        int top = 63 - __builtin_clzll(e);\n        for (int b = top; b >= 0; --b) {\n            if (b != top) r = squareMod(r);\n            if ((e >> b) & 1) mulXMod(r);\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nHD inline val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                     const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated, GPU)\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int OCT_STACK = 128;\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(const GpuNode& n, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - n.center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n    const Vec3& h = n.halfExtent;\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > h.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > h.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > h.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > h.y * ad.z + h.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > h.z * ad.x + h.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > h.x * ad.y + h.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const GpuNode* __restrict__ nodes, const int* __restrict__ octTris,\n                             const Triangle* __restrict__ tris, int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[OCT_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const GpuNode& n = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (n.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < n.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = octTris[n.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = tris[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n        for (int c = 7; c >= 0; --c) {\n            int ch = n.child[c];\n            if (ch >= 0 && rayIntersectsBox(nodes[ch], from, to)) stack[sp++] = ch;\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nHD inline val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\nHD inline Vec3 pointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// Generate one MT window (624 words) from the previous one; blockDim >= 624\n__device__ __forceinline__ void twistWindow(const uint32_t* prev, uint32_t* next) {\n    int w = threadIdx.x;\n    if (w < MT_N - MT_M) next[w] = mtWord(prev[w], prev[w + 1], prev[w + MT_M]);\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (w >= MT_N - MT_M && w < 2 * (MT_N - MT_M))\n        next[w] = mtWord(prev[w], prev[w + 1], next[w - (MT_N - MT_M)]);\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (w >= 2 * (MT_N - MT_M) && w < MT_N)\n        next[w] = mtWord(prev[w], w + 1 < MT_N ? prev[w + 1] : next[0], next[w - (MT_N - MT_M)]);\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// dst = poly(T) applied to src (MT jump-ahead), one state per block iteration\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(MT_N)\nmtJumpKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ src, uint32_t* __restrict__ dst, int count,\n             const uint64_t* __restrict__ poly, uint32_t* __restrict__ scratch) {\n    __shared__ uint64_t sp[POLY_WORDS];\n    for (int q = threadIdx.x; q < POLY_WORDS; q += blockDim.x) sp[q] = poly[q];\n    uint32_t* ext = scratch + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * MT_EXT_WINDOWS * MT_N;\n    const int w = threadIdx.x;\n    for (int item = blockIdx.x; item < count; item += gridDim.x) {\n        ext[w] = src[static_cast<size_t>(item) * MT_N + w];\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int k = 1; k < MT_EXT_WINDOWS; ++k) twistWindow(ext + (k - 1) * MT_N, ext + k * MT_N);\n        uint32_t acc = 0;\n        for (int q = 0; q < POLY_WORDS; ++q) {\n            uint64_t bits = sp[q];\n            while (bits) {\n                int b = __ffsll(static_cast<long long>(bits)) - 1;\n                bits &= bits - 1;\n                acc ^= ext[64 * q + b + w];\n            }\n        }\n        dst[static_cast<size_t>(item) * MT_N + w] = acc;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\nstruct KijParams {\n    const uint32_t* states;      // per block starting window\n    long long roundBase;         // first round handled by this rank\n    long long roundsPerBlock;\n    long long roundEnd;          // exclusive\n    long long pairBegin, pairEnd;// global pair range owned by this rank\n    const long long* rowStart;   // global prefix count of non-culled pairs (N+1)\n    const long long* culledOff;  // local rows (R+1)\n    const int* culledCols;\n    int r0, r1, n;\n    const Triangle* tris;\n    const GpuNode* nodes;\n    const int* octTris;\n    val_t* kij;                  // local rows, R x N\n};\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(MT_N, 2) kijKernel(KijParams P) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t win[5][MT_N];\n    __shared__ val_t rnd[RAND_PER_ROUND];\n    __shared__ val_t contrib[MT_N];\n    __shared__ int pi[PAIRS_PER_ROUND], pj[PAIRS_PER_ROUND];\n\n    const int t = threadIdx.x;\n    win[0][t] = P.states[static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * MT_N + t];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    long long rBegin = P.roundBase + static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * P.roundsPerBlock;\n    long long rEnd = min(rBegin + P.roundsPerBlock, P.roundEnd);\n\n    for (long long r = rBegin; r < rEnd; ++r) {\n        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) twistWindow(win[k], win[k + 1]);\n        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) rnd[k * MT_N + t] = mtToFloat(mtTemper(win[k + 1][t]));\n\n        if (t < PAIRS_PER_ROUND) {\n            long long pidx = r * PAIRS_PER_ROUND + t;\n            int ii = -1, jj = -1;\n            if (pidx >= P.pairBegin && pidx < P.pairEnd) {\n                int lo = P.r0, hi = P.r1 - 1;   // largest row with rowStart <= pidx\n                while (lo < hi) {\n                    int mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1;\n                    if (P.rowStart[mid] <= pidx) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1;\n                }\n                ii = lo;\n                long long kk = pidx - P.rowStart[ii];\n                const int* cols = P.culledCols + P.culledOff[ii - P.r0];\n                int cnt = static_cast<int>(P.culledOff[ii - P.r0 + 1] - P.culledOff[ii - P.r0]);\n                int a = 0, b = cnt;          // number of q with cols[q] - q <= kk\n                while (a < b) {\n                    int mid = (a + b) >> 1;\n                    if (cols[mid] - mid <= kk) a = mid + 1; else b = mid;\n                }\n                jj = static_cast<int>(kk) + a;\n            }\n            pi[t] = ii;\n            pj[t] = jj;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        {\n            int p = t / NUM_RAYS;\n            int ray = t % NUM_RAYS;\n            val_t c = ZERO;\n            int i = pi[p];\n            if (i >= 0) {\n                int j = pj[p];\n                const val_t* rr = rnd + p * RAND_PER_PAIR + ray * 4;\n                Triangle triI = P.tris[i];\n                Triangle triJ = P.tris[j];\n                Vec3 pI = pointInTriangle(triI, rr[0], rr[1]);\n                Vec3 pJ = pointInTriangle(triJ, rr[2], rr[3]);\n                if (!isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, P.nodes, P.octTris, P.tris, i, j)) {\n                    Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n                    val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n                    if (distSqr >= EPSILON) {\n                        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n                        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n                        if (cosPhiI > ZERO && cosPhiJ > ZERO) c = (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            contrib[t] = c;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        if (t < PAIRS_PER_ROUND && pi[t] >= 0) {\n            val_t kij = ZERO;\n            for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) kij += contrib[t * NUM_RAYS + ray];\n            P.kij[static_cast<size_t>(pi[t] - P.r0) * P.n + pj[t]] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n        }\n        win[0][t] = win[4][t];\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Convert Kij into propagation weights min(Kij*area_j, 1) and count non-zero Kij\n__global__ void weightKernel(val_t* __restrict__ kij, const val_t* __restrict__ areas,\n                             size_t total, int n, unsigned long long* nonZero) {\n    unsigned long long cnt = 0;\n    for (size_t e = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x; e < total;\n         e += static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {\n        val_t k = kij[e];\n        if (k > EPSILON) ++cnt;\n        kij[e] = k > ZERO ? fminf(k * areas[e % n], ONE) : ZERO;\n    }\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) cnt += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, cnt, o);\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0 && cnt) atomicAdd(nonZero, cnt);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (rank 0)\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // Distribution: this rank owns receiver rows [rowBegin, rowEnd)\n    int rowBegin = 0, rowEnd = 0;\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts, rowDispls;\n    unsigned long long nonZeroKij = 0;\n\n    // Device data\n    Triangle* dTris = nullptr;\n    GpuNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    int* dOctTris = nullptr;\n    val_t* dAreas = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRho = nullptr;\n    val_t* dW = nullptr;            // local rows: min(Kij*area_j,1), 0 if Kij<=0\n    uint16_t* dTau = nullptr;       // local rows\n    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;         // T x N\n    val_t* dDist = nullptr;         // local rows\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    int numSMs = 1;\n\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n    int localRows() const { return rowEnd - rowBegin; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(n, reflectivity);\n\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * n, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(n, ZERO);\n\n    // Row distribution over ranks\n    state.rowCounts.resize(g_size);\n    state.rowDispls.resize(g_size);\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        size_t b = n * static_cast<size_t>(r) / g_size;\n        size_t e = n * static_cast<size_t>(r + 1) / g_size;\n        state.rowDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(b);\n        state.rowCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(e - b);\n    }\n    state.rowBegin = state.rowDispls[g_rank];\n    state.rowEnd = state.rowBegin + state.rowCounts[g_rank];\n\n    // Device setup\n    std::vector<GpuNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<int> octTris;\n    int maxDepth = 0;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, nodes, octTris, maxDepth, 0);\n    if (7 * maxDepth + 8 > OCT_STACK) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep for traversal stack (%d)\\n\", maxDepth);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&state.stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n    int dev = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&dev));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&state.numSMs, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev));\n\n    const size_t R = static_cast<size_t>(state.localRows());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTris, n * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dNodes, nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dOctTris, std::max<size_t>(1, octTris.size()) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dAreas, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRho, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dW, std::max<size_t>(1, R * n) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTau, std::max<size_t>(1, R * n) * sizeof(uint16_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadB, std::max<size_t>(1, timesteps * n) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dDist, std::max<size_t>(1, R) * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTris, state.triangles.data(), n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodes, nodes.data(), nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!octTris.empty())\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dOctTris, octTris.data(), octTris.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dW, 0, std::max<size_t>(1, R * n) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, std::max<size_t>(1, timesteps * n) * sizeof(val_t)));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase (Tau on host with OpenMP, Kij on GPU, overlapped)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid precompute(SimulationState& state) {\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int r0 = state.rowBegin, r1 = state.rowEnd;\n    const int R = r1 - r0;\n    const std::vector<Triangle>& tris = state.triangles;\n\n    // --- Culling: pairs whose normals face the same way consume no random numbers\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> culled(R);\n    std::vector<long long> localCounts(R);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)\n    for (int li = 0; li < R; ++li) {\n        int i = r0 + li;\n        const Vec3 ni = tris[i].normal();\n        auto& lst = culled[li];\n        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            if (i == j || ni.dot(tris[j].normal()) > 0.99f) lst.push_back(j);\n        }\n        localCounts[li] = n - static_cast<long long>(lst.size());\n    }\n\n    std::vector<long long> allCounts(n);\n    {\n        std::vector<int> cnts(g_size), displs(g_size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) { cnts[r] = state.rowCounts[r]; displs[r] = state.rowDispls[r]; }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(localCounts.data(), R, MPI_LONG_LONG, allCounts.data(), cnts.data(), displs.data(),\n                       MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n    std::vector<long long> rowStart(n + 1, 0);\n    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) rowStart[i + 1] = rowStart[i] + allCounts[i];\n\n    std::vector<long long> culledOff(R + 1, 0);\n    for (int li = 0; li < R; ++li) culledOff[li + 1] = culledOff[li] + static_cast<long long>(culled[li].size());\n    std::vector<int> culledCols(std::max<long long>(1, culledOff[R]));\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int li = 0; li < R; ++li)\n        std::copy(culled[li].begin(), culled[li].end(), culledCols.begin() + culledOff[li]);\n\n    const long long pairBegin = rowStart[r0], pairEnd = rowStart[r1];\n    const long long roundBase = pairBegin / PAIRS_PER_ROUND;\n    const long long roundEnd = (pairEnd + PAIRS_PER_ROUND - 1) / PAIRS_PER_ROUND;\n    const long long localRounds = pairEnd > pairBegin ? roundEnd - roundBase : 0;\n\n    // --- Kij on the GPU\n    long long* dRowStart = nullptr;\n    long long* dCulledOff = nullptr;\n    int* dCulledCols = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dStates = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dSeed = nullptr;\n    uint64_t* dPolys = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dScratch = nullptr;\n\n    if (localRounds > 0) {\n        long long targetBlocks = static_cast<long long>(state.numSMs) * 16;\n        long long Rs = (localRounds + targetBlocks - 1) / targetBlocks;\n        int G = static_cast<int>((localRounds + Rs - 1) / Rs);\n        int levels = 0;\n        while ((1 << levels) < G) ++levels;\n\n        // Jump polynomials: A = x^(2496*roundBase), Q_b = x^(2496*Rs*2^b)\n        MtPoly mp;\n        mp.init();\n        std::vector<Poly> polys(levels + 1);\n        #pragma omp parallel sections\n        {\n            #pragma omp section\n            { polys[0] = mp.powX(static_cast<uint64_t>(RAND_PER_ROUND) * roundBase); }\n            #pragma omp section\n            {\n                if (levels > 0) {\n                    polys[1] = mp.powX(static_cast<uint64_t>(RAND_PER_ROUND) * Rs);\n                    for (int b = 1; b < levels; ++b) polys[b + 1] = mp.squareMod(polys[b]);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        std::vector<uint64_t> polyFlat(static_cast<size_t>(levels + 1) * POLY_WORDS);\n        for (int b = 0; b <= levels; ++b)\n            std::copy(polys[b].begin(), polys[b].begin() + POLY_WORDS, polyFlat.begin() + static_cast<size_t>(b) * POLY_WORDS);\n        uint32_t seed[MT_N];\n        mtSeedWindow(42u, seed);\n\n        const int jumpGrid = std::min(G, state.numSMs * 2);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dRowStart, (n + 1) * sizeof(long long)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dCulledOff, (R + 1) * sizeof(long long)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dCulledCols, culledCols.size() * sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dStates, static_cast<size_t>(G) * MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dSeed, MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPolys, polyFlat.size() * sizeof(uint64_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dScratch, static_cast<size_t>(jumpGrid) * MT_EXT_WINDOWS * MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n\n        cudaStream_t s = state.stream;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dRowStart, rowStart.data(), (n + 1) * sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dCulledOff, culledOff.data(), (R + 1) * sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dCulledCols, culledCols.data(), culledCols.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dSeed, seed, MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPolys, polyFlat.data(), polyFlat.size() * sizeof(uint64_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n\n        // Starting states of all blocks via a binary jump tree\n        mtJumpKernel<<<1, MT_N, 0, s>>>(dSeed, dStates, 1, dPolys, dScratch);\n        for (int b = 0; b < levels; ++b) {\n            int first = 1 << b;\n            int count = std::min(first, G - first);\n            mtJumpKernel<<<std::min(count, jumpGrid), MT_N, 0, s>>>(\n                dStates, dStates + static_cast<size_t>(first) * MT_N, count,\n                dPolys + static_cast<size_t>(b + 1) * POLY_WORDS, dScratch);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        KijParams P;\n        P.states = dStates;\n        P.roundBase = roundBase;\n        P.roundsPerBlock = Rs;\n        P.roundEnd = roundEnd;\n        P.pairBegin = pairBegin;\n        P.pairEnd = pairEnd;\n        P.rowStart = dRowStart;\n        P.culledOff = dCulledOff;\n        P.culledCols = dCulledCols;\n        P.r0 = r0;\n        P.r1 = r1;\n        P.n = n;\n        P.tris = state.dTris;\n        P.nodes = state.dNodes;\n        P.octTris = state.dOctTris;\n        P.kij = state.dW;\n        kijKernel<<<G, MT_N, 0, s>>>(P);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n\n    // --- Tau on the host (overlaps with the GPU form factor kernel)\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n    if (R > 0) {\n        uint16_t* hTau = nullptr;\n        const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(R) * n;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hTau, total * sizeof(uint16_t)));\n        int maxTau = 0;\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxTau)\n        for (int li = 0; li < R; ++li) {\n            int i = r0 + li;\n            uint16_t* row = hTau + static_cast<size_t>(li) * n;\n            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n                int tau = (i == j) ? 0 : computeTau(tris[i], tris[j]);\n                maxTau = std::max(maxTau, tau);\n                row[j] = static_cast<uint16_t>(tau);\n            }\n        }\n        if (maxTau > 65535) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Tau exceeds 16-bit storage\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(state.dTau, hTau, total * sizeof(uint16_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, state.stream));\n\n        if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n        unsigned long long* dNonZero = nullptr;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dNonZero, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(dNonZero, 0, sizeof(unsigned long long), state.stream));\n        weightKernel<<<state.numSMs * 8, 256, 0, state.stream>>>(state.dW, state.dAreas, total, n, dNonZero);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        unsigned long long nz = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&nz, dNonZero, sizeof(nz), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, state.stream));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(state.stream));\n        state.nonZeroKij = nz;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dNonZero));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hTau));\n    } else if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(state.stream));\n    cudaFree(dRowStart);\n    cudaFree(dCulledOff);\n    cudaFree(dCulledCols);\n    cudaFree(dStates);\n    cudaFree(dSeed);\n    cudaFree(dPolys);\n    cudaFree(dScratch);\n\n    unsigned long long totalNZ = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&state.nonZeroKij, &totalNZ, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    state.nonZeroKij = totalNZ;\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n                printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int SIM_WARPS = 8;\n\n// One warp per receiver row; lanes stride over emitters, fixed-order reduction\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SIM_WARPS * 32)\nsimStepKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ W, const uint16_t* __restrict__ tau,\n              val_t* __restrict__ radB, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,\n              int t, int n, int r0, int R, int src, int timeOff) {\n    int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    int li = blockIdx.x * SIM_WARPS + (threadIdx.x >> 5);\n    if (li >= R) return;\n    int i = r0 + li;\n    const val_t* wRow = W + static_cast<size_t>(li) * n;\n    const uint16_t* tRow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(li) * n;\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    for (int j = lane; j < n; j += 32) {\n        int tauij = tRow[j];\n        if (t < tauij || j == i) continue;\n        val_t w = wRow[j];\n        if (w <= ZERO) continue;\n        val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * n + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n        sumB += w * radJ;\n    }\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) sumB += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sumB, o);\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        val_t radE = (i == src && t < timeOff) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;\n        radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i] = rho[i] * sumB + radE;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int R = state.localRows();\n    const int T = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps);\n    const int timeOff = T / 2;\n    cudaStream_t s = state.stream;\n    const int grid = std::max(1, (R + SIM_WARPS - 1) / SIM_WARPS);\n\n    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        if (R > 0) {\n            simStepKernel<<<grid, SIM_WARPS * 32, 0, s>>>(state.dW, state.dTau, state.dRadB, state.dRho,\n                                                         t, n, state.rowBegin, R,\n                                                         static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex), timeOff);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n        val_t* hRow = state.radB.data() + state.idxTN(t, 0);\n        val_t* dRow = state.dRadB + state.idxTN(t, 0);\n        if (g_size > 1) {\n            if (R > 0)\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hRow + state.rowBegin, dRow + state.rowBegin, R * sizeof(val_t),\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(s));\n            MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, hRow, state.rowCounts.data(),\n                           state.rowDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dRow, hRow, n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n        }\n\n        if (g_rank == 0 && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T)) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %d/%d\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n    if (g_size == 1 && T > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(state.radB.data(), state.dRadB, static_cast<size_t>(T) * n * sizeof(val_t),\n                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(s));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB, val_t* __restrict__ dist,\n                               int n, int T, int r0, int R, int src) {\n    int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= R) return;\n    int i = r0 + li;\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n\n    // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * n + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * n + src];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    dist[li] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const int R = state.localRows();\n    std::vector<val_t> local(std::max(R, 1));\n    if (R > 0) {\n        distanceKernel<<<(R + 127) / 128, 128, 0, state.stream>>>(\n            state.dRadB, state.dDist, static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles),\n            static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps), state.rowBegin, R, static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(local.data(), state.dDist, R * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, state.stream));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(state.stream));\n    }\n    MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), R, MPI_FLOAT, state.distances.data(), state.rowCounts.data(),\n                state.rowDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = static_cast<int>(state.nonZeroKij);\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nstatic void selectDevice() {\n    MPI_Comm local;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, g_rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(local, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&local);\n    int devCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&devCount));\n    if (devCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % devCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));   // create context\n}\n\nstatic int finish(int code) {\n    fflush(stdout);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return code;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_size);\n\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (g_rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return finish(0);\n        } else {\n            if (g_rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return finish(1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    selectDevice();\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n        printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n        printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n        printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n        printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    precompute(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Simulation\n    auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    runSimulation(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto simDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();\n\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", simDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Distance computation\n    auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeDistances(state);\n\n    auto endDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto distDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endDist - startDist).count();\n\n    int rc = 0;\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Distance computation time: %ld ms\\n\", distDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n\n        // Total time\n        long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;\n        printf(\"Total computation time: %ld ms\\n\", totalTime);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n        size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n        double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n * n);\n        double
